fact: The World Bank's completion report of 16 June 2025 says ANSIE lacked salary budget to hire additional staff, that retaining technical consultants was needed to sustain results, and that tax-administration modernisation was hindered by the government's limited capacity to manage complex IT projects and its dependence on an international vendor (SOGEMA) for the ITAS system.
title: Implementation Completion and Results Report, Credit 6627-DJ, Public Administration Modernization Project
